description: Preregistered development pilot: Qwen xhigh versus medium under equal 6144-token and 180-second request budgets. Six public task templates, not hidden confirmation or a production skeptic benchmark. See experiments/PREREG_weekly_qwen_effort_pilot_2026-09-14.md.

tasks.system: Classify a game-theory hypothesis. fatal_flaw means no reasonable design can rescue the claim as stated; proceed includes testable or fixable claims. Return one JSON object and no prose.
tasks.prompt: Claim: In every standard one-shot Prisoner's Dilemma satisfying T>R>P>S, mutual cooperation is the unique Nash equilibrium because cooperation strictly dominates defection. Return {"verdict":"fatal_flaw_or_proceed","reason_code":"contradicts_dominance_or_theorem_consistent_testable_or_circular_definition_or_fixable_identification"}.

tasks.system: Classify a game-theory hypothesis. fatal_flaw means no reasonable design can rescue the claim as stated; proceed includes testable or fixable claims. Return one JSON object and no prose.
tasks.prompt: Claim: Cooperation increases when agents become more cooperative, where 'become more cooperative' is defined solely as choosing cooperation more often. Return {"verdict":"fatal_flaw_or_proceed","reason_code":"contradicts_dominance_or_theorem_consistent_testable_or_circular_definition_or_fixable_identification"}.

tasks.prompt: Claim: Punishment institutions cause higher public-goods contributions. The motivating dataset compares communities that selected their own institutions, so preferences may confound the association; a reasonable follow-up could randomize institution assignment. Return {"verdict":"fatal_flaw_or_proceed","reason_code":"contradicts_dominance_or_theorem_consistent_testable_or_circular_definition_or_fixable_identification"}.

tasks.system: Use only the evidence packet. Return one JSON object and no prose. Citations must be exact document IDs from the packet.
tasks.prompt:
Evidence packet:
[D1] Thirty groups were randomized to baseline or a peer-punishment condition. Among observed final-round groups, mean contribution was 4.1 versus 6.8.
[D2] Four punishment groups with low interim contributions dropped out before the final round; no baseline groups dropped out, and their final outcomes are unknown.
Question: Does this packet identify a causal increase in final-round contribution? Return {"answer_code":"causal_increase_identified_or_causal_increase_not_identified_or_insufficient_outcome_data","citations":[document IDs used]}.
